scenes.label: Deskhand
scenes.headline: Tell your computer what to do.
scenes.text: Meet Deskhand. Tell your computer what to do, in your own words.

scenes.label: 1 · Sign in
scenes.text: Sign in with just your email. No password.

scenes.label: 2 · Connect your computer
scenes.text: First time? Copy one command, paste it into PowerShell, and your computer connects itself.

scenes.label: 3 · Ask in plain words
scenes.text: Ask for anything in plain words. The bubble even reacts to your cursor. Pull it far, and the theme flips.

scenes.label: 4 · Watch it work
scenes.text: Watch every step in plain English. When it's unsure, it asks with buttons. Then you get the result.

scenes.label: 5 · Pick the computer
scenes.text: More than one computer? Choose where it runs, or pick several.

scenes.label: 6 · Just say it
scenes.headline: Alt + F8
scenes.typed: open calculator and add seven and five
scenes.text: Or press Alt and F8 anywhere, and just say it.
scenes.say: Or press Alt and F eight anywhere, and just say it.

scenes.label: 7 · Keep using your computer
scenes.text: It works in its own window, so you keep using your computer.

scenes.label: Chrome extension
scenes.headline: Works in your own signed-in Chrome
scenes.sub: A small extension, approved once by you, lets Deskhand use the accounts you are already logged in to.
scenes.text: A small Chrome extension lets it work in your own signed-in browser, once you approve it.

scenes.label: 8 · Simple settings
scenes.text: Settings is simple boxes. Switch theme, check usage, or hit emergency stop.

scenes.label: 9 · You stay in control
scenes.headline:
Safety runs on your computer,
not inside the AI
points: Only approved apps, folders and sites
Emergency stop, always one tap away
scenes.text: Safety rules run on your computer, not inside the AI.

scenes.label: How it fits together
scenes.headline: How it fits together

nodes.title: Deskhand server
nodes.sub: Yours: queues work, enforces the rules

nodes.title: Deskhand for Windows
nodes.sub: Runs on each computer you connect

scenes.text: The web app talks to your own Deskhand server, which sends work to the app on each computer you connect. It drives native apps, and Chrome through the extension.

scenes.label: Deskhand
scenes.headline: Say it. It is done.
scenes.text: Deskhand. Say it, and it's done.
